title: Ending a Ridgecrest Advantage Enrollment and Withdrawing an Application Not Yet in Force
content:
Only the member, or a representative they have appointed in writing, may end a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment or withdraw an application; the plan never ends coverage at a provider's or a relative's request.

**Condition of record.** A request to end the enrollment is recorded on the enrollment intake with the request action of voluntary disenrollment and an intake status of recorded, awaiting the member's signature, or submitted to CMS, before the enrollment is ended. The enrollment intake record is the authority, tested before the enrollment is ended and matched on the reference of that request.

### Two different endings

**A voluntary disenrollment** takes effect on the last day of the month in which the plan received the request, and the member keeps full coverage until that day.

**An application withdrawn before the coverage effective date** leaves no coverage period at all: the enrollment is cancelled before it ever takes effect and the disenrollment reason recorded is that it was withdrawn before the coverage was due to begin. The further words of that clause, *and any premium already paid is refunded in full*, are no longer in force and are not applied to a withdrawn Ridgecrest Advantage application.

### Where a member goes on leaving

A member who disenrolls outside an election period returns to Original Medicare rather than to another Medicare Advantage plan, and the plan says so plainly before the request is recorded.

### What else ends on the same day

Ending the medical plan ends the supplemental benefit allowance card and every optional supplemental benefit rider on the same day, and whatever allowance is left on the card is forfeited rather than paid out.

### A disenrollment already sent to CMS

A disenrollment already transmitted to CMS is withdrawn only by a further member request inside the same month; the plan never reverses it on its own initiative.

*The plan receives a member's request to leave on 12 March.* Coverage runs to 31 March and the member keeps full coverage until that day; the allowance card and any rider end on the same day.
